about_the_game:
Hidden Cats of Atlantis

Embark on a mysterious journey to Atlantis, searching for playful cats among crystal palaces, underwater temples, and bustling coral markets. Can you find them all?

Game Features:
• Over 100 unique hidden cats waiting to be discovered
• Beautifully hand-drawn Atlantean scenes, from underwater gardens to ancient ruins
• Relaxing soundtrack inspired by deep-sea music
• Perfect for short breaks - find a few cats at a time, save your progress, and return anytime

Take a break from daily life with this casual hidden object game. Each cat has its unique personality and hiding style, bringing surprises with every discovery.

Note: Base game includes one complete level.
